description.html: The anchor with corals is a decorative piece that enriches your aquarium with a nautical theme. The anchor model overgrown with artificial corals creates the impression of a sunken ship's anchor that nature has slowly taken over - as if it has been lying on the seabed for decades. The combination of the anchor's metallic look and colorful corals adds interesting contrast and visual depth to the aquarium. It is safe for underwater use - made from quality material that does not release harmful substances and does not affect water chemistry, pH or hardness. Ideal for creating a nautical theme in combination with the ship wheel and pirate ship for a complete marine atmosphere. The corals on the anchor can also serve as a visual accent in aquariums where live plants are not an option. It is easy to clean with a gentle rinse under running water during regular maintenance.
